I am a Master's student in the Social Data Analytics and Research program at the University of Texas at Dallas. My academic focus integrates advanced machine learning techniques with practical data analysis and visualization.

## Research Interests

- Deep learning architectures for computer vision and medical image analysis.
- Spatiotemporal neural networks for weather forecasting (e.g., Fourier Neural Operators).
